subject.title: feat(dashboard): add unlisted OpenClaw Bay demo

question: Should the hosted ClawSweeper dashboard publish this guessable public `/bay-demo` experiment with bounded non-ledger status semantics?
rationale: The remaining choice is whether ClawSweeper should permanently own another public hosted experience and whether unlisted access is sufficient; code correctness alone cannot establish that product intent.

options.title: Sponsor the unlisted demo
options.body: Accept the experimental public route and bounded visualization after inspectable live proof confirms the claimed behavior.

options.title: Require access control
options.body: Retain the prototype but protect it with Cloudflare Access or application authentication before deployment.

options.title: Decline the hosted surface
options.body: Keep only the existing operational dashboard and do not deploy this experiment.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the unlisted demo
recommendation.body: Accept the experimental public route and bounded visualization after inspectable live proof confirms the claimed behavior.
